key_insight: AI can help decode, predict, and mitigate the instability of 3D all-inorganic perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms to practical design strategies.
engineering_relevance: For CsPbX3 devices, AI offers a route to improve reliability under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress while reducing trial-and-error optimization.
method: Microscopic mechanism analysis across coupled degradation pathways
evidence_signal: The review highlights multimodal data, sparse statistics, protocol dependence, and uncertainty quantification as central evaluation challenges in current stability studies.
watch_item: Performance can be misleading if datasets, testing protocols, and labels are inconsistent across studies, limiting transferability and benchmark fairness.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
